title: First principles
src: Aristotle, Metaphysics, and later engineering practice
idea: Break a problem down to what is certainly true, then build up from there instead of copying how it has always been done.
apply: Write the problem. Cross out every assumption. Keep only what you know is true and rebuild the plan from that.
remind: Ask what is actually true. Then build from there.
who: Dee, who thinks getting fit needs a gym and an hour a day.

items.x: Find an hour every single day

scenes.nar: Dee wants to get fit. Her plan says she needs a gym, an hour every day, and new gear. She keeps putting it off.

items: I need an hour a day
Muscles need load a few times a week
The heart needs a raised pulse

scenes.nar: So she crosses out what she assumed and writes down only what is true. Muscles need load. The heart needs a raised pulse. And she has twenty minutes before work.
Built from that, her plan becomes a twenty minute home circuit, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

scenes.sub: The plan fits her real life.
scenes.nar: Three weeks in, she has not missed a session. The plan fits her real life, so she keeps it.
